Our newly complete zero changes read classification only and does not write negative evidence or new row proofs; it cannot independently authorize compaction.

This touches pending-overlay/item publication around the one-client regression, so retain real owner frames, old snapshot identity and atomic compaction controls.

Native reads switch to cached statements without changing SQL/predicates/binds. update/upsert reuse the just-fetched preimage with no intervening writes; unique probes cache only within one constraint invocation while duplicating original trace evidence. Certificate pricing and owner receipt classification are unchanged. Focused index replacement/merge and real-owner regressions cover the integration.
